articles.title: Data-Provider Stocks Tumble on AI Competition Fears
articles.mainIdea: Data-Provider Stocks Tumble on AI Competition Fears
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Data-Provider Stocks Tumble on AI Competition Fears. Financial data-provider stocks dropped after artificial-intelligence company Anthropic announced it added new functions for legal users of its Cowork assistant. While shares of European legal publishers were the first to drop, the selloff quickly expanded to market-data heavyweights. Related tickers mentioned: ANTH.PVT, EFX, FDS.
